mapper.select: select ifnull(checkwarn.warnnum,0) warningnum /*预警*/ ,ifnull(checkfail1.failnum,0)+ifnull(checkfail2.failnum,0) failnum /*不通过*/ ,ifnull(checkwarn.warnnum,0)+ifnull(checkfail1.failnum,0)+ifnull(checkfail2.failnum,0) as submitChecknum /*报送检查*/ ,ifnull(checkwarn.rep_code,checkfail1.rep_code) reporttype /*报表类型*/ from (select count(check_result) warnnum,rep_code from chb_report_check where check_result='03' and DATE_FORMAT(DATA_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'%Y-%m-%d') group by rep_code ) checkwarn left join (select count(check_result) failnum,rep_code from chb_report_check where check_result='02' and DATE_FORMAT(DATA_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'%Y-%m-%d') group by rep_code) checkfail1 on checkwarn.rep_code = checkfail1.rep_code right join (select count(check_result) failnum,rep_code from chb_report_check where check_result='02' and DATE_FORMAT(DATA_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{searchDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP},'%Y-%m-%d') group by rep_code) checkfail2 on checkwarn.rep_code = checkfail2.rep_code
